keywords: 北极熊当选 Glamsterdam 吉祥物
summary: ACDE #242 据 Ethereal news #33：Platåberget 是短期无许可公共测试网，目标 8 月初，使用基于基准测试更新的重定价数值并仅用 discv5；Hegotá 新提案包括 Etan Kissling 的 EIP-8115、8116、7807，Derek Chiang 的 EIP-7819 SETDELEGATE，forshtat 的 EIP-7906，以及 EIP-7668、8200、7666；北极熊当选吉祥物。当天 EIPs 仓库大量合并：EIP-7732（ePBS）、8045、8061、2780 移至 Review，8115、8116、7807、7906 进入 Hegotá 候选列表。Marchhill 提交 EIP-8141 规范 paymaster 的 355 字节参考字节码。

items.title: EIP-8141：规范 paymaster 的参考字节码
items.note: （Marchhill）提交，延续 #12012：355 字节运行时实现调度、付款验证、存款和四项带时间锁的管理操作（提款/轮换发起、取消、完成），并给出按分叉识别的 keccak256 code hash。
items.title_en: EIP-8141: assembled canonical paymaster reference bytecode
items.note_en: (Marchhill), submitted, continuing #12012: a 355-byte runtime implementing dispatch, payment validation, deposit and four timelocked admin operations (withdrawal/rotation initiate, cancel, finalize), plus a keccak256 code hash as the per-fork recognition anchor.

items.title: EIP-8250：定义 keyed 内存池并发
items.note: （soispoke）提交：8250 给 frame 交易独立的重放域，但内存池仍沿用 8141 每个 sender 只能有一笔待处理交易的限制；PR 定义一个窄的可选例外，key 0 和验证依赖可变的交易仍受该限制。
items.note_en: (soispoke), submitted: 8250 gives frame transactions independent replay domains, but the mempool kept 8141's limit of one pending frame transaction per sender; the PR defines a narrow optional exception, with key zero and transactions with mutable validation dependencies still under the sender limit.

keywords_en: polar bear chosen as Glamsterdam mascot
EIP-7732 and others move to Review
summary_en: Per Ethereal news #33, ACDE #242 covered Platåberget, a short-lived permissionless public testnet targeting early August with benchmark-based repricing numbers and discv5 only; new Hegotá proposals include Etan Kissling's EIP-8115, 8116 and 7807, Derek Chiang's EIP-7819 SETDELEGATE, forshtat's EIP-7906, and EIP-7668, 8200 and 7666; the polar bear was chosen as mascot. The EIPs repo saw many merges: EIP-7732 (ePBS), 8045, 8061 and 2780 moved to Review, and 8115, 8116, 7807 and 7906 entered the Hegotá candidate list. Marchhill submitted 355-byte reference bytecode for EIP-8141's canonical paymaster.
